report.verdict: A strong senior backend resume for a management role that asks for direct-report experience it doesn't show.
write_up: Cobalt Pay is looking for an engineering manager, while your resume points to senior backend engineering. Your payments work is strong: you built a payouts service and led a ledger migration, but the resume doesn't show the people management this role asks for.

Your balance API line is a great model! It names the change you made and shows the latency before and after. The rest of your recent work is similarly easy to follow, and your progression from insurance to freight to payments makes sense.

For this application, bring your mentoring and incident-review work closer to the top. If you've managed direct reports, hired or handled performance reviews, add that experience plainly. For senior backend roles, your resume itself is unlikely to be the sticking point; the competition for a particular job matters too.

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 3
cards.line: Cut p99 latency on the balance API from 900 ms to 140 ms by moving reads to a Kafka-fed cache
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It connects a technical choice to a measurable improvement without making the reader guess what you did.

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 2
cards.line: Led the migration of the ledger from a single Postgres instance to a sharded cluster with zero downtime over six weekends
cards.cannot_tell: For the next technical level, a cross-team decision would show how your leadership reached beyond the migration itself.
cards.example: Led the migration of the ledger from a single Postgres instance to a sharded cluster with zero downtime over six weekends, including [cross-team technical decision you led]
cards.question: What cross-team technical decision, if any, did you lead during the migration?

fit.why: Your headline and recent work building payouts and ledger services point to senior backend engineering.
fit.level: senior, leads technical projects and mentors two mid-level engineers
fit.note: Your payouts, ledger and production operations work fits the team's subject matter. Bring the mentoring and incident-review lines forward for this application, and add any relevant management work the resume leaves out.
